title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（野村一樹研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Nomura Kazuki)
educationalGoal: The foundation of Food technology (Food engineering) is a chemical-engineering process based on the idea that "more effectively". Predecessors have developed a chemical-engineering process for "safer" and "more efficient" processing of foods. The objectives are to understand the basic principles of food technology and to present novel ideas in this field. Also, the purposes are to learn the ideas of improving the quality, branding, expanding distribution, and local contribution by focusing on the local food products, to plan your future activities.
advice:
This laboratory focuses on the local food products and studies the following research themes.

1. Improving the quality and branding of the local food products.
・Development and evaluation of the novel processing and storage technologies.

2. Reducing agricultural damage caused by wild birds and animals.
・Development and evaluation of  an effective utilization method of the gibier (meat of the wild birds and animals).

3. Clarification of processing mechanism of the traditional products.
・Analysis of various mechanism, such as fermentation, production, and degradation of each component.
requiredKnowledge:
Basic knowledges of biology, chemistry, physics, statistics, and food and nutrition.
Basic experimental techniques acquired in "Basic Experiments and Practice in Bioscience and Chemistry" and "Applied Bioscience Major Lab/Exercises"
"Advanced Bioengineering" and "Multidisciplinary Practices for Applied Bioscience" are also recommended.
Safety first.

activityGoals.body: To able to understand and explained the basic principles of food technology.
To able to understand the qualities of food and changes caused by processing.
To able to understand numerically and discussed logically changes caused by processing and storage.
To able to create presentations and reports based on logical considerations.

              The foundation of Food technology (Food engineering) is a chemical-engineering process based on the idea that "more effectively". Predecessors have developed a chemical-engineering process for "safer" and "more efficient" processing of foods. The objectives are to understand the basic principles of food technology and to present novel ideas in this field. Also, the purposes are to learn the ideas of improving the quality, branding, expanding distribution, and local contribution by focusing on the local food products, to plan your future activities.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This laboratory focuses on the local food products and studies the following research themes.

1. Improving the quality and branding of the local food products.
・Development and evaluation of the novel processing and storage technologies.

2. Reducing agricultural damage caused by wild birds and animals.
・Development and evaluation of  an effective utilization method of the gibier (meat of the wild birds and animals).

3. Clarification of processing mechanism of the traditional products.
・Analysis of various mechanism, such as fermentation, production, and degradation of each component.
